title: Coordinates for circles in animations are incorrect.
description: Thanks for this package it's pretty sweet! I am running into issues trying to animate circles or ellipses. Here's a reprex where the coordinates of a circle and its animation are getting a bit messed up. I couldn't figure out how to include the animated svg in the issue. My apologies! The orange circle is where the animated red cirlce should end up. Blue is where it should start. But note where red is in the screen shot. It is not between the two. ```r SVG(width = 500, height = 500) |> # animation should start at (300, 300) and end up at (25, 30) svg_circle(300, 300, diameter = 30, fill = 'red', anims = anims( 1.0 ~ anim_position(x = 10, y = 25) )) |> # should be origin svg_circle(300, 300, 30, fill = "blue") |> # should be the destination svg_circle(10, 25, 30, fill = "orange") ```

title: Don't display the <defs> tag if there are no graphical objects being stored
description:
Right now, `<defs>...</defs>` is always displayed.

```r
SVG(width = 250, height = 100) %>%
  svg_rect(x = 25, y = 25, width = 50, height = 50, fill = "yellow") %>%
  svg_ellipse(x = 125, y = 50, width = 50, height = 50, stroke = "magenta") %>%
  svg_text(x = 175, y = 50, text = "this is text", attrs = svg_attrs_pres(font_family = "Helvetica"))
```

```
#> <svg width="250px" height="100px" viewBox="0 0 250 100" version="1.1" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
#> <defs>
#> 
#> </defs>
#> <rect x="25" y="25" width="50" height="50" fill="yellow"/>
#> <ellipse cx="125" cy="50" rx="25" ry="25" stroke="magenta"/>
#> <text x="175" y="50" font-family="Helvetica">this is text</text>
#> </svg>
```
